claims: Continue insulin sliding scale subcutaneous administration for glycemic control, given fingerstick glucose values above target range (155-227 mg/dL).
Monitor blood glucose via fingerstick checks every 4-6 hours to guide insulin dosing.
Continue nicardipine infusion at current rate for blood pressure control.
Continue supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula at 2 L/min to maintain SpO2 above 92%.
Monitor arterial blood pressure and heart rate continuously via arterial line.
Monitor oxygen saturation via pulse oximetry with alarm limits as set.
Perform Braden scale assessment each shift to guide pressure injury prevention.
Obtain basic metabolic panel in 24 hours to assess renal function and electrolytes.
Obtain complete blood count in 24 hours to monitor hemoglobin and platelets.
Maintain bed rest with assistance for mobility as indicated by fall risk assessment.
